no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for review to an advisory committee because the safety profile of patisiran is acceptable for the intended population, the clinical trial design is acceptable, and the efficacy findings were clear.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for ONPATTRO (patisiran, NDA210922). The approval letter states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because the safety profile was acceptable for the intended population, the trial design was acceptable, and the efficacy findings were clear. Earlier administrative correspondence had noted only the possibility of an AC meeting during development/review, but none was ultimately held, so there was no AdCom influence on the approval.
